records.name: Tempsens Instruments
strengths: Largest manufacturer of temperature sensors in India by revenue.
Diversified business across temperature sensing, electrical heating, and specialised cables.
A customized, make-to-order business model creates high entry barriers.
Strong global presence with exports to a wide range of countries.
Backward-integrated manufacturing facilities provide control over the production process.
risks: High concentration of manufacturing units in a single location (Udaipur).
A significant portion of revenue comes from exports, creating foreign exchange risks.
Dependence on the availability and price stability of key raw materials.
The business is dependent on maintaining stringent and various international accreditations.
Performance is linked to demand trends in cyclical end-user industries like metals.
records.about_company: Tempsens Instruments is a thermal engineering and specialized cable manufacturer engaged in the design and production of customized temperature-sensing, electrical-heating, and specialized cable solutions. The company operates across three verticals. Its temperature sensing products include thermocouples and infrared pyrometers. The electrical heating segment offers industrial heaters and furnaces, while its cable division manufactures power, control, and instrumentation cables. The company generates revenue by providing custom-built, make-to-order solutions for demanding industries such as steel, petrochemicals, and glass manufacturing. Tempsens utilizes a backward-integrated manufacturing model, allowing control over the entire production cycle from alloy melting to final calibration. With a diversified revenue stream, the company serves both original equipment manufacturer and maintenance markets, maintaining a balanced market presence through domestic sales and an export footprint spanning over 70 countries.

records.name: Augmont Enterprises
strengths: An integrated player with offerings across the gold value chain.
Operates a B2B platform and a B2C platform for digital gold and silver.
In-house refining capabilities with a combined annual capacity of 284 tonnes.
Presence across 24 states in India as of March 31, 2026.
High revenue growth, with a CAGR of 64.23% from Fiscal 2024 to Fiscal 2026.
risks: The business is highly dependent on two online platforms; any disruption can impact operations.
Reliance on third-party payment gateways exposes the company to transaction-related risks.
The company operates in a competitive industry, and its success depends on its ability to adapt.
An external agency has not appraised the proposed utilization of IPO proceeds.
There are no directly comparable listed peers for investors to benchmark against.
records.about_company: Augmont is an integrated digital platform for gold and silver, with presence across nearly the entire value chain. It procures raw gold bars and refines them into bullion to sell via two platforms.
